name: realtime-avatar-sdk
description: Realtime Avatar SDK — live voice and video characters you can interrupt.

scripts.build: npm run build -w libs/sdk-server && npm run build -w libs/mcp && npm run build -w libs/examples
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run boundary && npm run messages && npm run surface && npm run reachable && npm run spec:verify && npm run externals && npm run derivation && npm run apps:python
scripts.spec: npm run spec:pull && npm run spec:types
scripts.spec:verify: openapi-typescript spec/realtime-avatar.openapi.json -o /tmp/rta-generated-check.ts && diff -q /tmp/rta-generated-check.ts libs/http-client/src/generated/openapi.ts && node scripts/generate-clip-schema.mjs --check
